question: Can generic script context and shorter independent windows repair source scripts and English fidelity with existing models?
qwen: Same pinned1.7B FP16 greedy448; auto language.20s with generic context,10s no context,10s same context. Full20s no-context baselines already saved.
native: Same official large-v3 FP16 memory-efficient loader; beam5/fallback; fixed10s windows, fresh auto language, no previous text/prompt; transcribe and translate. Full20s baselines already saved.
reassembly: Chronological raw concatenation only. No guessed joins, dropped text or deduplication; cuts may interrupt words.
acceptance: Any observed script/critical clear-span fidelity failure rejects tested configuration. No model accepted by keyword coverage. Partial/unclear references prohibit full-window WER and independent full-Hindi meaning scoring.
uncertainty: Opening action token and probably status unresolved;85Hindi meaning not independently checked; no inference on unintelligible65.
bound: No downloads; one load per model,20Qwen generations and16Whisper tasks. Max1200s sampled health/headroom guard; own runtime removed afterward.

comparison.method: Agent clear-span inspection against frozen expectations, not direct audio perception or full bilingual semantic adjudication.

configurations.context20: Rejected: mixed English remains phonetic Devanagari; signup-responsibility recognition error persists on English control. Generic script prompt is not a reliable repair.
configurations.plain10: Rejected: mixed English remains phonetic Devanagari; second half of listener-confirmed English Atlas clip also becomes Devanagari. No source-script acceptance.
configurations.context10: Rejected for the same mixed-script failure and English-control script regression; no evidence of semantic repair.

qwen.english_control: Central/Chef and uncertainty/negation are largely retained on first English clip; this does not override failure on other clips.
qwen.script_boundary: Digit/Latin fragments do not establish source-script fidelity; recognizable English speech still appears phonetically in Devanagari.

native10.recognition_decision: Rejected: confirmed mixed sample source is partially translated toEnglish and question-bearing second half becomes garbled output after Sinhala LID prediction. Other mixed sample loses checked model-choice clause in source.
native10.translation_findings: Opening diagnostic retains checked date and travel question/answer, and later mixed sample retains checked central pricing/model-choice English content. These limited agreements do not establish Hindi translation correctness.
native10.english_control_failure: English Atlas clip still fails signup responsibility, changing the substantive phrase rather than repairing recognition.
native10.coverage_limit: Opening amount/credit coverage in later mixed clip remains unresolved; no checked complete Hindi meaning. Earlier probably discrepancy remains excluded.
native10.language_detection: Sinhala prediction on question-bearing half of confirmed Hindi-English diagnostic is not evidence of actual Sinhala speech. Shorter fresh-language windows can be unstable.
native10.translation_decision: No acceptance. Partial improvement on mixed clear English clauses, but a substantive English-control error remains and no complete checked Hindi meaning exists.

decision.reason: Source-script and clear substantive recognition failures persist; shorter cuts introduce severe source regressions. Stop this bounded context/10s tuning path. Do not infer all segmentation, future models or fine-tuning are ruled out.
decision.product_status: Two-artifact model-quality gate remains blocked. Do not update product implementation to deploy any tested configuration.
